sql: SELECT i.unit, s.follow_up_4_enabled, s.follow_up_4_delay_hours, s.follow_up_4_message, (s.follow_up_4_image_url IS NOT NULL) AS tem_imagem, s.follow_up_3_delay_hours, s.follow_up_3_message FROM wapi_bot_settings s JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = s.instance_id WHERE i.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND i.is_active ORDER BY i.unit
